BiblicalUsage: A bribe by another name is still a bribe, and Isaiah uses this word for the rewards the princes loved. Every one loveth gifts, he says, and followeth after rewards, and they judge not the fatherless.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a bribe is a bribe whatever you call it, and the princes who loved gifts had already sold their justice.
